In light of this breakthrough, Unit1 has secured a further $20M of new investment to fuel its work creating and operating mixed reality avatar concerts, transporting fans to legendary performances from the artists they love. While ABBA Voyage has proven audience appetite for concerts of artists who can no longer tour, the eye-watering costs of development and replication of similar productions has proved prohibitive for a majority of artists. Itoflow raises $2.5 million to bring institutional-grade portfolio management to every investment firm - Balderton Capital × About Us Wellbeing & Performance Platform Our Values Sustainable Future Goals Balderton Launched Our team Companies All companies Founder spotlights Careers Resources News Portfolio News 25 August, 2026 Itoflow raises $2.5 million to bring institutional-grade portfolio management to every investment firm Balderton Itoflow, the AI platform helping professional investment teams scale research and portfolio management, has raised $2.5 million in pre-seed funding led by Balderton and including angel investors such as Cleo founder Barney Hussey-Yeo. Itoflow will use the funding to expand its engineering and quantitative research teams, accelerate product development and support its commercial and regulatory work. Founded in 2026, Itoflow is building AI agents that learn how each investment firm researches opportunities, manages risk and reviews portfolios. The platform does not impose a particular investment philosophy: it turns each team’s own approach into governed workflows that can operate continuously across global markets and asset classes, including equities, bonds, ETFs, commodities and digital assets.
